counterhypotheses.claim: Raw generative VLM media-token embeddings are not a calibrated user-specific identity/open-set space. Strong multimodal embedding systems derived from VLMs use explicit contrastive/multi-stage adaptation, so a dedicated lightweight embedding baseline may remain Pareto-superior for MVC even if a second heavy semantic stack is unnecessary.
counterhypotheses.test: Compare raw pooled Qwen mmproj descriptors, tiny projected Qwen descriptors and a dedicated lightweight frozen embedding baseline with identical prototype/open-set readout and complete pathway resource accounting.

counterhypotheses.claim: Decoder bypass may save less than expected if the 24-layer Qwen vision tower dominates sensor-to-state cost on the 4-CPU target VPS. In that case deterministic change gates and a truly smaller vision path matter more than 4B->2B decoder downsizing.
counterhypotheses.test: Decompose capture/preprocess, vision encode, MVC, prompt processing and decode at fixed token budgets for 0.8B/2B/4B.

counterhypotheses.claim: Perceptual EAP/ActiveAssembly can create confirmation loops: wrong high-confidence visual seeds may improve apparent contextual coherence while worsening sensor-grounded correctness.
counterhypotheses.test: Wrong-seed, shuffled-topology, stale-layout, near-neighbor unknown and no-EAP controls; current sensor evidence must remain epistemically dominant.

counterhypotheses.claim: Aggressive changed-region cropping can remove background/layout state that recent GUI research finds useful for state-transition reasoning and grounding.
counterhypotheses.test: ROI-only vs ROI+context vs adaptive quadtree vs full-frame under matched visual-token budgets, including hidden modal/notification fixtures.
